name: How to Rob A Gas Station
long_description: In this game you, get this, rob a gas station. In fact, it's a step by step tutorial on robbing a gas station. Since this game is about 5 minutes, there are multiple endings. So if you care, you can do all the endings. There are a total of 22 endings.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
